quote: The creation of subsequent Election to Work Agreements shall follow the procedure in Subd. 4 above.
subject_text: The creation of subsequent Election to Work Agreements

quote: Restructured Schools shall be evaluated on an annual basis through examination of student achievement data and other appropriate measures of school success.
This review shall be performed by a joint committee comprised of equal numbers of members of the District and the Union.
This committee will also review Restructured School practices, procedures, staffing and school leadership to identify practices and approaches that should be duplicated or avoided.
